Name: Posit Connect manifest.json
Content: Posit Connect can use rsconnect::writeManifest() to generate manifest.json, capturing exact R package versions and metadata. When you deploy Git-backed content, committing manifest.json helps Connect recreate the same package environment.

Name: GitHub Actions connect-publish
Content: Use rstudio/actions/connect-publish@main to publish Shiny R apps to Posit Connect from your GitHub repo. Configure secrets CONNECT_SERVER and CONNECT_API_KEY and set the workflow 'dir' to the app folder.
Keywords: connect-publish; GitHub Actions; Posit Connect; CONNECT_SERVER

Name: Shiny R app entry point
Content: A Shiny R app commonly uses app.R as the primary document containing ui/server definitions. When deploying to Posit Connect, you typically set appmode to 'shiny' and primary_rmd/app.R so Connect knows how to run it.

Name: Alpha Vantage TIME_SERIES_DAILY
Content: Alpha Vantage TIME_SERIES_DAILY provides daily OHLCV time series. Requests typically use function=TIME_SERIES_DAILY, symbol=<TICKER>, and apikey=<API_KEY> to fetch the 'Time Series (Daily)' data.

Name: Ollama local endpoint /api/chat
Content: Ollama runs a local REST API (default port 11434). Chat completions are sent to http://localhost:11434/api/chat with a JSON body containing model and messages.

Name: Ollama model tags
Content: Ollama models are referenced by tags such as smollm2:135m. You typically pull models first (ollama pull <tag>) and then use the tag in your API calls.

Name: RAG search over CSV
Content: In CSV-based RAG, you implement a search() that filters rows relevant to a query, then converts the retrieved rows to JSON for the LLM. The system prompt instructs the model to answer using only the retrieved context.
Keywords: RAG; CSV; search(); JSON to LLM

Name: RAG search over text files
Content: In text-based RAG, you read lines from a .txt file, filter matching lines (e.g., with grep), and pass the retrieved text to the LLM as context. The system prompt emphasizes using only retrieved lines.

Name: RAG search over SQLite
Content: In SQLite-based RAG, you connect with DBI/RSQLite, run SQL LIKE queries against a documents table, then convert results to JSON for the LLM. The system prompt instructs the model to summarize based on retrieved documents.
Keywords: SQLite; DBI; SQL LIKE; documents table

Name: FDA Drug Shortages API
Content: The FDA Drug Shortages API can be queried for current shortages. Example usage filters by therapeutic_category and dosage_form, then reads results containing fields like generic_name, update_date, and availability status.
